documents.text:
Draft for review · Updated October 18, 2026

Privacy Policy

Operator: Bryan Porter (Missouri, United States of America). Contact: inquiries@bryanporter.com (mailto:inquiries@bryanporter.com). These drafts are pending review and do not yet have an effective date.

1. Information we handle

When you sign in through Google, Microsoft, or Apple, we receive identity information from that provider. We store the provider identifier linked to your account, profile information such as your chosen display name and any saved avatar URL, account and identity timestamps, and session records. We do not store your provider password or long-lived provider access or refresh tokens.

We store your voyage titles, descriptions, publication and location-precision choices, uploaded photos, original uploads, generated image variants, and photo metadata. Metadata can include exact coordinates, capture times, dimensions, and camera details extracted from EXIF. Removing metadata from displayed images does not remove the exact metadata stored by the service.

Operating the service also involves request information such as IP addresses, browser headers, request times, errors, and security events at the application or hosting layer. Optional diagnostic tracing records request and processing activity. If you contact us, we handle the information you send.

2. Why we use information

We use information to sign you in, maintain accounts and sessions, process and display photos and maps, apply privacy settings, answer requests, investigate abuse, protect the service, and meet legal obligations. Where applicable law requires a legal basis, these activities rely on providing the requested service, legitimate interests in security and operation, legal obligations, or consent where required. You may withdraw consent for processing based on consent by contacting us.

3. Public voyages, drafts, and location

Published voyages are public. Their photos, voyage text, display name, and map locations can be viewed and copied by others. Public map coordinates follow the voyage’s chosen precision; selecting exact precision exposes exact coordinates. Rounded locations and visible landmarks can still reveal where a photo was taken.

Draft voyages and their photos are restricted to the owner through normal service access. Administrators can view draft titles and descriptions for account moderation; that interface does not grant access to private photos. Authorized operators and infrastructure providers may access stored data as needed for operation, security, or legal obligations. Owner-only photo metadata includes exact coordinates. We serve re-encoded images with embedded metadata stripped, never original uploads.

4. Cookies and other providers

We use cookies for sign-in security and server-side sessions. Blocking these cookies prevents sign-in from working. Signing out revokes the current session. The application does not currently include advertising or third-party analytics trackers.

Sign-in providers receive information when you authenticate with them. Your browser also requests map tiles directly from OpenStreetMap’s tile service, which receives your IP address, browser request information, and the requested tile area. Tiles can reveal the area you are viewing. See the OpenStreetMap Foundation privacy policy (https://osmfoundation.org/wiki/Privacy_Policy) and your chosen sign-in provider’s policy. Hosting and infrastructure providers process data needed to run the service.

5. Sharing and legal disclosures

We do not sell personal information or share it for targeted advertising. We share information with providers as needed to operate the service, when you direct us to publish content, and as legally permitted or required to protect people and rights, investigate abuse, or respond to lawful requests. Content we deem illegal will be referred to appropriate authorities; relevant evidence and account information may be preserved or disclosed as permitted or required by law.

6. Retention, deletion, and security

We retain account data and uploads while needed to provide the service and for security, dispute resolution, and legal obligations. Deleting a photo or voyage removes its database records and queues unused files for background cleanup; this does not erase every stored copy immediately. Shared files can remain while another upload references them. Backups, logs, and legally preserved records can outlast deletion. We cannot remove copies other people have saved.

Retention periods for hosting logs, diagnostics, and backups: [operator to confirm before this policy takes effect]. We use access controls and session protections, but no storage or transmission method guarantees complete security. Hosting locations and international transfer safeguards: [operator to confirm].

7. Your choices and requests

You can edit your display name, unpublish voyages, change location precision, and delete photos or voyages using the service. Previous display names remain reserved or available as aliases to protect account routing. There is no self-service account deletion at present; request account deletion at inquiries@bryanporter.com (mailto:inquiries@bryanporter.com). We may need to verify that you own the account before acting.

Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or obtain a copy of personal information, restrict or object to processing, and complain to your data protection authority. Contact inquiries@bryanporter.com (mailto:inquiries@bryanporter.com) to exercise these rights. Legal exceptions and identity-verification requirements may apply.

8. Children, updates, and contact

Accounts and uploads are intended for adults aged 18 or older. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. Contact us if you believe a child has supplied information so we can investigate and take appropriate action. We will update the date when this policy changes and provide additional notice where required by law. Questions: inquiries@bryanporter.com (mailto:inquiries@bryanporter.com). Effective date: [to be confirmed after review].

Terms of Service

Operator: Bryan Porter (Missouri, United States of America). Contact: inquiries@bryanporter.com (mailto:inquiries@bryanporter.com). These drafts are pending review and do not yet have an effective date.

1. Using PinVoyager

These terms govern your use of PinVoyager, the photo and voyage mapping service operated by the operator identified above ("we", "us"). By using the service after these terms take effect, you agree to them. If you disagree, stop using the service. You must be at least 18 and able to enter a binding agreement to create an account or upload content. Keep your sign-in provider account secure and tell us about suspected unauthorized use. Our Privacy Policy explains data handling.

2. Your content and permissions

You retain ownership of your photos, voyage descriptions, and other submissions ("user content"). You are responsible for their legality, accuracy, and consequences. Upload only material you own or have permission to use, including permission needed from people pictured and for any personal information or locations you disclose.

You grant us a nonexclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to store, copy, process, re-encode, and display your content to operate and protect the service, and to let our hosting providers do that work for us. Public display follows your publication choices. This license ends when content is removed from the service, except for copies reasonably needed for backups, legal compliance, or resolving disputes. It does not transfer ownership.

Publishing makes your voyage and its photos public. Location precision follows your chosen setting, including exact locations if selected. Others may save or redistribute public material; unpublishing or deletion cannot recall their copies. Keep your own backups.

3. Prohibited content and conduct

Do not upload illegal material, child sexual exploitation material, nonconsensual intimate images, threats, harassment, hateful abuse, private information disclosed without permission, fraudulent material, or content that infringes others’ rights. Do not impersonate people, distribute malware or spam, evade suspensions, bypass security or upload limits, or disrupt the service. This list does not limit our discretion to remove other content we consider objectionable.

4. Removal, suspension, and reporting to authorities

We reserve the right to refuse, restrict, unpublish, or remove any user content at any time, for any reason, at our sole discretion. Content we deem objectionable in our sole discretion will be removed without warning or prior notice. We may also suspend or terminate accounts or access to the service. We need not provide advance notice or compensation, except where applicable law requires otherwise.

Any content we deem illegal will be referred to the appropriate authorities. We may preserve relevant evidence and disclose content and related account information as permitted or required by law. A referral reports suspected illegality; it is not a court determination. These terms do not promise continuous monitoring or review of every upload. Mandatory notices, reasons, and review rights under applicable law remain available.

5. Hosted content and third parties

To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not responsible for user content or any harm arising from it. Hosting does not mean that we endorse, verify, or guarantee its accuracy, safety, legality, or suitability. You view and rely on user content at your own risk. Maps and photo locations are informational and may be inaccurate; do not rely on them for navigation or safety. Sign-in and map providers operate under their own terms and privacy policies.

6. Content and copyright complaints

Send complaints to inquiries@bryanporter.com (mailto:inquiries@bryanporter.com) with the specific voyage or photo URL, the reason for the complaint, and your contact details. For copyright complaints, identify the protected work, the allegedly infringing material, and your authority to act for the rights holder. We may remove disputed content and terminate repeat infringers in appropriate circumstances. Any legally required notice, counter-notice, or appeal process applies. Do not send illegal images as attachments.

7. Service availability and liability

We provide the service as available, without guarantees of uninterrupted access, permanent storage, or freedom from errors. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we disclaim implied warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, and noninfringement, and exclude liability for indirect or consequential losses, including lost data or profits arising from use of the service or hosted content. Nothing excludes liability or consumer rights that the law does not allow us to exclude.

8. Changes, disputes, and contact

We may change or discontinue the service. Revised terms will show an updated date; material changes take effect 30 days after posting unless a different period is required by law or an urgent legal or security change is necessary. We will provide additional notice when legally required. Continued use after the effective date constitutes acceptance to the extent permitted by law.

Missouri law and applicable United States federal law govern these terms. Disputes may be brought in the state or federal courts with jurisdiction in Missouri. Mandatory local consumer protections remain applicable. If a provision is unenforceable, the remaining terms continue to apply. Questions and complaints: inquiries@bryanporter.com (mailto:inquiries@bryanporter.com). Effective date: [to be confirmed after review].
